ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 55% low-intensity (black) pixels and 45% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in mottling patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white-to-light-grey mottling consisting of small circular and irregular blobs across both lobes; solid black pigmentation is concentrated around the central peduncle insertion and along the medial trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees and significant depth reaching toward the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations; prominent triangular excisions on the inner-left lobe and multiple U-shaped notches across the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the peduncle, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small, circular white pixel clusters (punctate scarring) distributed across the entire visible ventral surface, particularly dense on the distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-aligned linear disruptions of pigment visible on the right lobe near the median notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural loss (notches) along the trailing edge of both lobes; presence of brownish-tan textured biological clusters (likely barnacles) attached to the distal tips of both flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant accumulation of stalked or sessile organisms creating a distinct textured fringe on the extreme lateral fluke tips.
